metadataReview.note: Reviewed extent: 6–8 September 1793. The Gendarmerie nationale heritage account explicitly dates the fighting to those three days and calls 8 September the last day of the battle. Preserve the final assault date as the end while restoring the earlier fighting as the start. This is the Hondschoote battle, not the whole Dunkirk siege. The account’s gendarmerie-unit numbers are not converted to whole-army totals. CDB90 covers only 6 September and remains held.
